prompt: My Hebrew Word document looks perfect in LibreOffice — text is right-aligned, bullets are on the right. But when I open it in Microsoft Word, all the text is left-aligned and the bullet points appear on the left side. What are the root causes of this? Please provide a complete Python script that I can run on any Hebrew .docx to fix these RTL issues, without needing to unpack the file manually.

assertions.description: Response explains that RTL requires both paragraph-level <w:bidi/> AND run-level <w:rtl/>
Response mentions that a missing Normal style causes Word to auto-create an LTR default
Response notes that LibreOffice masks these issues and is not a valid test
Response includes a Python script that takes input and output file paths
The fix script uses Python's zipfile module to read/write the docx
The fix script addresses numbering.xml (bullet direction fix)
